purpose: Freeze the additive adapter-v7 contract for explicitly reviewed Italian textual-month dates and exact reviewed tabular summary-row dispositions without changing the immutable adapter-v6 contract.

lifecycle.promotion_requires: a fresh independently authored unseen holdout sealed after these exact extension-contract bytes and the candidate implementation are frozen

base_contract.rule: Every v5 requirement remains applicable unless this extension states a narrower additive rule.

v7_when: date_locale is explicitly reviewed and non-null
non_movement_summary_labels contains at least one explicitly reviewed label
selection.v6_when: date_locale is null and non_movement_summary_labels is empty

review_authority.mutation_rule: Changing either extension authority requires a new mapping receipt bound to the current source and adapter-v7 bytes.

localized_date_contract.accepted_textual_shape: D or DD, one or more horizontal spaces, full Italian month name, one or more horizontal spaces, YYYY
space_normalization: U+00A0 NO-BREAK SPACE to ASCII space
U+202F NARROW NO-BREAK SPACE to ASCII space
localized_date_contract.calendar_rule: The parsed year, month, and day must form one valid Gregorian calendar date.
localized_date_contract.existing_numeric_dates: The complete adapter-v6 native, Excel-serial, compact-ISO, year-first, and reviewed day_first/month_first rules remain available.
localized_date_contract.date_convention_scope: date_convention applies only to ambiguous numeric day/month forms and does not authorize textual-month parsing.

reviewed_summary_contract.authority_shape: a sorted list of unique, non-empty labels after the production label normalization
row_is_excluded_only_if: the mapped date cell is truly blank
explicit reference and movement-number fields contain no stable non-generic reference token
the normalized mapped description exactly equals one reviewed summary label
non_override_rules: a row with an actual date is not excluded by the label
a row with a stable reference is not excluded by the label
substring and fuzzy label matches are forbidden
an unreviewed label has no exclusion authority
reviewed_summary_contract.mutation_rule: Any label-list mutation makes the mapping receipt stale and emits zero authoritative rows pending a new review.

complete_population_rule.qualified_candidate_count: populated mapped monetary rows excluding exact reviewed non-movement summary rows
complete_population_rule.invalid_candidate_outcome: one invalid in-scope monetary candidate withholds the complete source

assurance_scalability.native_value_scope: every material match and relationship-residual value remains checked in prepared, CSV, and XLSX addresses
assurance_scalability.xlsx_traversal: read-only worksheets are traversed sequentially by row; repeated random cell access is forbidden
assurance_scalability.quality_rule: performance optimization may not reduce value, row, worksheet, dimension, duplicate-member, receipt, or replay closure

deterministic_justification.localized_dates: The accepted vocabulary, token shape, calendar validity, and ISO normalization are mechanically verifiable and require exact replay.
deterministic_justification.summary_rows: The reviewer owns the semantic label; deterministic code enforces only the exact receipt-bound label and structural blank-date/no-reference predicate.
